## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

The pricing rule lives in `orders/domain/checkoutTotals.ts` and the cart-rule
evaluation in `domain/cartRuleEvaluation.ts`. Both are pure on purpose: they
decide what a customer is charged, so they must be readable and testable
without a database.

Order of operations is load-bearing and must not be rearranged: merchandise
subtotal, then packet tier, then shipping, then cart rules, then voucher, then
loyalty. A voucher is measured against the subtotal _after_ rule discounts, so
a rule and a voucher can never discount the same amount twice.

Money is rounded to the cent at every step through `roundMoney`. Accumulating
unrounded floats and rounding once at the end produces different totals.

<!-- invariants:end -->
